verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own materials say Ari proactively messages users when something moves, and the pricing page lists "Proactive alerts & triggers", so the core proactive-notification capability is first-party. The evidence never specifies alerts on variance against plan or reminders before reporting deadlines, and there is no description of how triggers are configured. missing for 10: documented plan-vs-actual variance alerts, reporting-deadline reminders, trigger/threshold configuration docs, notification channel details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform notifies me when a metric moves against plan or a reporting deadline approaches, before I ask

citations.quote: Ari builds the model and keeps it current, then messages you when something moves rather than waiting to be asked.
tells you what changed before you ask
